Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy lived. The boy liked to play with his toys. One day, he saw a cheap, big ball in the park. He was very happy and played with the ball all day.
The boy saw a girl near the mountain. She was sad because she had no toys to play with. The boy thought for a moment and decided to share his ball with the girl. The girl was very happy, and they played together. They had a lot of fun.
But, the ball got stuck in the mountain. The boy tried to get it down, but he could not. The ball went into the mountain, and the girl went home. The boy was sad because he lost his ball and his new toy. The moral of the story is: do not take things that do not belong to you.

, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to play with her toy animals. One day, she saw a tiny bird on the ground. The bird looked hurt and had a dirty body.
Lucy went to her mom and said, "Mom, my bird is hurt. Can we help it?" Her mom looked at the bird and said, "Yes, Lucy, we can delay our playtime and help the bird. But first, we need to clean the bird's wing."
So, Lucy and her mom cleaned the bird's wing. They put a warm cloth on the bird's wing. After a while, the bird's wing was clean and not hurt anymore.
The bird was so happy that it sang a beautiful song for Lucy and her mom. They all lived happily ever after.
The moral of the story is to always be kind and helpful to others, because it can make everyone feel better.
